_comment: Stands in for the analysed project's composer.json in rule tests under tests/src/Drupal11. Rules bonded through ComposerPackageConstraintInterface state a closed range, so no single version can activate every rule: a rule for an API removed in Drupal 10 caps at <11.0.0, one deprecated in 11.4 starts at >=11.4.0. Each major therefore gets its own pin, high within the major so every rule in that set is active.
